newsitem.title: USA: Somatogen Inc says to restructure.
newsitem.headline: Somatogen Inc says to restructure.

text.p: Somatogen Inc Tuesday announced it would cut 67 full and part-time employees, leaving it with 137 employees, as part of a restructuring while it reviews and reprioritizes its projects.
Somatogen is restructuring its operations because of Eli Lilly and Co's decision last month to discontinue support for rHb1.
A company spokesman said rHb1.1 is a recombinant hemoglobin drug in the clinical development stage.

Somatogen's President, Chairman and CEO, Andre de Bruin, said the company's "immediate priorities are to expeditiously complete our current Optro(R) clinical studies and develop our next generation recombinant hemoglobin technology. We have restructured and focused our company to achieve these objectives in a cost effective way."
Somatogen is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the research, clinical development and commercialization of genetically engineered recombinant human hemoglobin-based products.
